traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Do not confuse Harsha's art with the Gupta 'Golden Age' style; Harsha's period shows signs of decline in stone sculpture quality.
Remember that Harsha was not a grand builder of new temple complexes; he is better known for patronage of Buddhist Viharas.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in Kanauj (Kanyakubja)
  • Expansion to Thanesar
  • Nalanda as the educational hub

Personalities

  • Harshavardhana: Royal Patron
  • Hiuen Tsang: Chronicler
  • Banabhatta: Literary insight

Architectural Evolution

  • Transition phase between Gupta-Vakataka styles and early Medieval architecture.
  • Focus on Vihara expansion rather than grand Hindu temple building.
  • Use of terracotta and brick in structural designs.
FeatureHarsha Period Trend
MaterialBrick/Wood dominance over Stone
ReligionBuddhist Viharas vs. early Hindu shrines
DecorationShift towards ornate floral motifs
